pages.text: SYN Market Wire weekly wrap for the week ending 2026-05-22. The SSE All-Share Index closed the week ending 2026-05-22 at 2,066.19 points. The 91-day Treasury bill auction that week cleared at 9.16 percent. Weekly turnover on the exchange was SYN Sh 1,832 million. The top gainer of the week was Mlima Holdings (SYN).

Market participants said the move reflected steady demand from retail and institutional investors. Officials declined to comment on whether further changes were planned.
